title: Quick Tip: What’s in Business Central 2026 Release Wave 2, Update 29.1?
summary: Business Central 2026 Wave 2 Update 29.1 introduces new features in finance (cross-environment master data management, fixed asset journal approvals, payment batch totals, excise duties), agents (Payables Agent for credit notes, Expense Agent for trip-based reports), administration (Match Production Configuration for sandbox testing), e-documents (self-billing), and country-specific functionality for Belgium, Austria, Iceland, Germany, France, and Czechia.
key_points: Update 29.1 is the first minor update for 2026 release wave 2 with new features across finance, copilot/agents, governance, and localization

Several features are in preview (cross-environment MDM, excise duties, Match Production Configuration, self-billing, country-specific enhancements) while others are now generally available (fixed asset approvals, payment batch totals, Payables Agent)
Match Production Configuration lets admins temporarily mirror production database behavior in sandbox for performance testing, limited to 72 hours and three activations per tenant per month
Agents now handle new scenarios: Payables Agent processes vendor credit notes; Expense Agent creates trip-based reports with interim approver support
New customers are deployed directly on 29.1; existing online customers receive update notifications and can schedule upgrades through Admin Center

quotes.text: Match Production Configuration (preview) lets administrators temporarily configure a sandbox database to resemble a typical production database.
quotes.why_it_matters: This feature directly addresses performance testing needs by allowing admins to test against production-like configurations without affecting live systems

quotes.text: One thing worth watching is the distinction between public preview and general availability.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that not all 29.1 features are production-ready, so users must verify feature status before implementation
